files.description: Cloud storage accounts (150 rows): account_id (whole number), active (True or False), quota_bytes (storage limit in bytes, whole number; the 23 unlimited accounts carry the value 9223372036854775807), used_bytes (whole number). No empty cells.

task_text: Each account gets a control total: its active flag counted as 1 (True) or 0 (False), plus quota_bytes, plus used_bytes. Add up the control totals separately for the active and the inactive accounts. `result` should be a Series indexed by the active value (False, True) with exact whole numbers.
intended_computation: Exact integer sums of the control totals for active == False and for active == True.

predicted_direction.reason: The control totals of unlimited accounts wrap around in 64-bit integers on 3.1 (exact on 2.x), so both group sums are wrong on 3.1.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row I06; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
